sentence: "Remember that time we got lost in Westlands and ended up at a wedding uninvited?",
"My little brother tried to pay for sweets with leaves thinking they were money.",
"You won't believe what my boss did during the meeting today, it was so embarrassing.",
"I accidentally sent a voice note complaining about my date to the date himself.",
"My phone autocorrected 'meeting' to 'mating' in a work email, I wanted to disappear.",
"That matatu conductor started rapping about the traffic jam like it was a music video.",
"I tried to be cool and wink at someone but ended up blinking both eyes.",
"My aunt's chicken followed her into the house and tried to sit on the sofa.",
"You should have seen me trying to parallel park while everyone was watching.",
"My friend's toddler tried to feed chapati to the TV during cartoon time.",
"I accidentally liked my ex's photo from three years ago while stalking his profile.",
"The power went out right when I was telling the scariest part of my story.",
"My dad tried to use Google Maps but ended up navigating us to a river.",
"I wore my shirt inside out all day and nobody bothered to tell me.",
"My sister put salt instead of sugar in her tea and drank it anyway.",
"I tried to impress a date by ordering in French but the waiter was Kenyan.",
"My phone fell in the toilet right when I was taking a selfie, typical.",
"You know you're tired when you try to unlock your house with the car remote.",
"My nephew asked if babies come from Amazon during our family dinner conversation.",
"I spent ten minutes searching for my glasses while they were on my head.",
"That awkward moment when you call your teacher 'mum' in front of the whole class.",
"My friend tried to microwave metal cutlery because she wanted warm utensils.",
"I sneezed so hard in the library that everyone turned to look at me.",
"My cousin thought 'LOL' meant 'Lots of Love' and used it in a condolence message.",
"I tried to jump over a puddle and ended up sitting right in it.",
"My brother put ketchup on his mandazi thinking it was some kind of sauce.",
"I spent twenty minutes arguing with a customer service bot before realizing it wasn't human.",
"My phone played music randomly during a serious meeting about budget cuts.",
"I walked into a glass door thinking it was open, the sound was so loud.",
"You know that feeling when you're nodding off and suddenly jerk awake in public.",
"My friend tried to pay with expired coupons and argued with the cashier for ages.",
"I sent a screenshot to the person I was complaining about in the screenshot.",
"My mom tried to use TikTok and ended up recording two hours of the ceiling.",
"I wore two different shoes to work and only noticed during my lunch break.",
"That moment when you're telling a joke and forget the punchline completely.",
"My neighbor's dog brought me his own leash when he wanted to go for walks.",
"You should have seen me trying to dance to gengetone at the club last weekend.",
"My cousin thought WiFi was free everywhere and kept asking for passwords in public.",
"I accidentally replied 'I love you too' to my boss's 'thank you for your work'.",
"My sister put her phone in the fridge while looking for the butter.",
"I tried to take a cool Instagram photo but a pigeon photobombed the whole thing.",
"That awkward silence when you finish a story and nobody laughs or responds.",
"My friend tried to order pizza using Google Translate from English to English.",
"I spent fifteen minutes trying to remember the name of that actor we saw yesterday.",
"You know you're broke when you start considering walking from Westlands to town.",
"My nephew asked if we could download more RAM for his slow computer.",
"I tried to be romantic and cook dinner but set off the smoke alarm instead.",
"My phone autocorrected 'see you soon' to 'see you spoon' in a professional email.",
"I walked around with my zip open for hours before my friend pointed it out.",
"My cousin thought 'Netflix and chill' meant literally watching Netflix while feeling cold.",
"I tried to take a shortcut and ended up in someone's backyard in Lavington.",
"That awkward moment when you realize you've been pronouncing a common word wrong forever.",
"My mom tried to use voice commands and ended up calling everyone in her contacts.",
"I spent thirty minutes looking for my phone while talking on it with my mom.",
"My friend tried to speak with a British accent and sounded like a cartoon character.",
"I accidentally sent my grocery list to the group chat instead of my sister.",
"That time I tried to be fancy and order wine but couldn't pronounce the name.",
"My neighbor's parrot learned to say 'help me' and caused a neighborhood panic.",
"My brother thought he could fix the TV by hitting it like in the movies.",
"I tried to be mysterious and wear sunglasses indoors but kept bumping into things.",
"That moment when you're telling a serious story and suddenly burst out laughing.",
"My cousin tried to return a clearly used item claiming it was 'defective from factory'.",
"I spent the whole day thinking it was Thursday when it was actually Friday.",
"You know you're hungry when you start considering eating your colleague's lunch from the fridge.",
"My friend tried to be environmentally friendly and washed disposable plates to reuse them.",
"I accidentally shared my screen with personal messages during an important Zoom presentation.",
"That awkward silence when you realize you've been talking to the wrong person on phone.",

"I walked past my own car three times in the parking lot before recognizing it."

"My sister just put salt in her tea instead of sugar, the scream was legendary.",
"My friend tried to teach me TikTok dances and I looked like a wounded giraffe.",
"Remember when you tried to parallel park and blocked traffic for like fifteen minutes?",

"I tried to be romantic and cook dinner but set off the smoke alarm instead.",
"My phone autocorrected 'see you soon' to something inappropriate in the family group chat.",
"That time you tried to pronounce 'supercalifragilisticexpialidocious' and gave up halfway was adorable.",

"My cousin told the funniest story about getting chased by geese at City Park yesterday.",

"You won't believe the ridiculous excuse my boss gave for being late this morning.",
"I nearly died laughing when my neighbor's cat stole my sausage right off the plate.",
"That story you told about your first matatu experience had me in stitches all day.",
"I can't stop thinking about your hilarious impression of our maths teacher from high school.",
"You always know how to make me laugh even when I'm having the worst day.",
"Your storytelling is so cute when you get all animated and wave your hands around.",
"I'm so tired of people repeating that same boring story at every family gathering."
Honestly, I don't find those exaggerated office prank stories believable or even slightly amusing.
You telling funny stories is my favorite thing, it always makes me smile so much.
Why do you always have to share those cringey stories when we're with other people?
